stories.title: Show HN: A language model that lives in a boot sector
summary: The pointer to the biases table was stored in edx, which resulted in the first neuron being biased correctly and the following ones using garbage.
Another bug I found simply by looking at the code before I did my first run-through: the BIOS print routine zeros out bx, but bx contains the predicted character number.
It is the trade-off in the opposite direction, as my engine needs to fit into one sector and therefore my network has just one hidden layer of int8 operations for dreaming the dmesg.

stories.title: ‘Apologies for any confusion!’: how to write the perfect passive-aggressive email
summary: In a survey, ‘just to be clear’ came out as the most loathed phrase.
Further down the list came “for future reference” and “kindly note”.If you ask me, these all verge on actual aggressive.

It’s the kind of thing you unleash 10 minutes into an ill-tempered wrangle with your home insurance company about inflated renewal premiums. “Kindly note” is even worse – it’s a phrase from an angry message on the office kitchen wall about microwave abuse.
